prompt:
Flat sumi-e ink wash painting on aged warm paper. Hand-painted, not rendered. A single isolated subject on plain paper, centred, whole subject in frame. Dark tapering brush outline, flat even ink-wash fill, uniform ambient tone with no visible light source, no cast shadow, no sheen. Monochromatic warm grey from pale paper to near-black ink. Brush character at every edge.

Subject: one old Japanese stone lantern (a toro, kasuga style), a solid heavy object seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above so that its top and two sides show. From the bottom up: a low wide hexagonal stone base, a thick round stone post, a wide flat hexagonal platform, a squat hexagonal light box with one small square window opening on each visible face, a broad hexagonal stone roof with gently upturned corners, and a small rounded finial on top. Chunky, weathered, slightly irregular hand-cut stone with chipped edges. Every surface the same mid-grey ink wash; the window openings near-black. It is unlit: no flame, no glow. No moss, no grass, no dots or small marks around the edge.

Plain empty paper background and nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no cliff wall, no mist, no clouds, no shadow, no text, no seal. Whole subject in frame with a paper margin all round.
